title: I built an online tabletop app with a bunch of different game options to play with friends.
author: Bk4180
selftext:
Basically what the title says. There are currently 12 different tabletop games you can play online with friends for free. You can also set any game to be 'Ranked' so that you can gain/lose MMR depending on the outcome of the game.

There's also a generic score keeper you can access in the dashboard, if you're playing something that doesn't exist in the app currently. It has typical scoring types like team modes, cumulative scoring, tally scoring, etc. useful for any type of real, in-person game night :)

Give it a look and let me know what you think! I'd also appreciate any bug reports since I have only ran a few games with friends and then the rest with bots, so my testing hasn't been as thorough as I'd like
